en.summary: Casa do Farol is a newly rebuilt 4-BR villa on Porto’s seafront in elite Foz, 10 min to the historic centre by riverside drive or vintage tram. Wake to Atlantic views, sip sunset cocktails on the rooftop, then sleep in climate-controlled suites with hotel-quality beds and ensuites. Oak floors, artful lighting, chef’s kitchen, 500 Mb/s Wi-Fi, beach towels, weekly clean, easy free parking at the door. Quiet, safe, authentic, city buzz without the crowds.
en.space:
Step inside this stunning villa and discover an open-plan entertaining space on the ground floor. Here, the living room, dining area, and kitchen flow seamlessly, complemented by a convenient powder room. Enjoy your evenings with a selection of board games, books, TV, and a dedicated wine bar.
The first floor features a comfortable office, a bedroom with a shared bathroom, and a lovely, cozy waterfront suite complete with a walk-in closet and private bathroom.
Ascend to the second floor where a tranquil reading nook awaits. The exquisite master suite on this level offers direct access to a patio, perfect for lounging or savoring sunset drinks and nibbles with breathtaking waterfront views. The master suite also includes exercise equipment and yoga mats for a private retreat.
In addition, on the ground level, there's a laundry space equipped with machines, here it's also where you can store any bike that you may have rented.

pt.summary: A Casa do Farol é uma moradia de 4 quartos, acabada de reconstruir, à beira-mar na Foz, a zona mais exclusiva do Porto, a 10 minutos do centro histórico pela marginal do rio ou de elétrico histórico. Acorde com vista para o Atlântico, beba um cocktail ao pôr do sol no terraço e durma em suites climatizadas com camas de qualidade de hotel e casa de banho privativa. Soalho de carvalho, iluminação cuidada, cozinha de chef, Wi-Fi de 500 Mb/s, toalhas de praia, limpeza semanal e estacionamento gratuito e fácil à porta. Sossegada, segura e autêntica: a vida da cidade sem multidões.
pt.space:
Ao entrar nesta moradia deslumbrante, encontra no rés-do-chão um espaço aberto pensado para receber: a sala de estar, a sala de jantar e a cozinha ligam-se naturalmente, com um lavabo à mão. Passe as noites com jogos de tabuleiro, livros, televisão e um bar de vinhos só seu.
No primeiro andar há um escritório confortável, um quarto com casa de banho partilhada e uma suite acolhedora virada para o mar, com closet e casa de banho privativa.
No segundo andar espera-o um recanto de leitura tranquilo. A magnífica suite principal deste piso tem acesso direto a um terraço, perfeito para descansar ou para uma bebida e uns petiscos ao pôr do sol, com vistas de cortar a respiração sobre o mar. A suite principal inclui ainda equipamento de exercício e tapetes de ioga, para um refúgio só seu.
Ainda no rés-do-chão, há uma lavandaria com máquinas, onde pode também guardar as bicicletas que tenha alugado.

en.summary:
This 2nd floor charming and sunny apartment is located in a recently renovated early 20th century building, right in the center of the Porto's old town. 
Wake up in a bright apartment full of local character, featuring a ceiling fan in the bedroom for warm days, kitchenette and washing machine. The design combines comfort with simplicity which is great for travelers who value authenticity. Like many heritage gems, there’s no elevatorand occasional sounds from the wooden stairs may be heard, adding to the authentic charm and atmosphere of old Porto. Just outside, charming cafés, restaurants, and boutique shops invite you to explore the city on foot.
en.space: We furnished, decorated and stocked the apartment with products made by young Portuguese designers, artists and producers, so you can feel Porto’s heart without leaving home, while supporting small scale entrepreneurs.

Este apartamento encantador e soalheiro, no 2.º andar, fica num edifício do início do século XX renovado há pouco tempo, mesmo no centro histórico do Porto.

Wake up in the heart of Porto with the breathtaking Clérigos Tower almost within arm’s reach. From this charming 3rd-floor studio, you’ll enjoy unforgettable views over the iconic Torre dos Clérigos and the beautiful Jardim das Oliveiras, one of the city’s most picturesque corners. Imagine opening the window in the morning, hearing the bells of Porto, and stretching your arms toward one of Portugal’s most famous landmarks.
Set inside a historic building full of character and authenticity, this cozy studio places you in Porto’s vibrant historic center, just steps away from the city’s best cafés, wine bars, traditional restaurants, local shops, and cultural attractions. Whether you’re here for sightseeing, photography, romantic walks, or simply to experience the soul of Porto, this location is truly unbeatable.
Like many authentic European city-center buildings, the property does not have an elevator, and the lively surroundings may bring some daytime and evening city noise. But in return, you’ll experience the real Porto: vibrant, charming, and full of life right outside your door.
This is more than just a place to stay, it’s an authentic Porto experience, surrounded by history, culture, and one of the most iconic views in the city.

Experience Porto at its most enchanting. Our charming studio apartments sit in a historic building right across from the iconic São Bento Station, placing you in the very heart of the old town. Step outside and you’ll find yourself surrounded by winding streets, cozy cafés, and traditional restaurants, with the Douro River just a leisurely 10-minute stroll away.

Each studio is a warm and welcoming retreat, thoughtfully designed to capture the spirit of Porto. The atmosphere is intimate and full of character - ideal for couples or travelers seeking an authentic stay in the city.

As with many historic gems, our building does not have an elevator, and ongoing underground works nearby may bring some daytime noise. Yet, these little quirks come with the privilege of staying in one of the most central and atmospheric corners of Porto, where history and romance meet at your doorstep.

Viva o Porto no seu melhor. Os nossos encantadores estúdios ficam num edifício histórico mesmo em frente à emblemática estação de São Bento, no coração da cidade antiga. À porta, encontra ruas sinuosas, cafés acolhedores e restaurantes tradicionais, com o rio Douro a apenas 10 minutos de passeio.

Cada estúdio é um refúgio caloroso e acolhedor, pensado para captar o espírito do Porto. O ambiente é íntimo e cheio de carácter, ideal para casais ou para quem procura uma estadia autêntica na cidade.

Como em muitas joias antigas, o edifício não tem elevador, e as obras subterrâneas em curso ali perto podem trazer algum ruído durante o dia. Ainda assim, estes pequenos pormenores vêm com o privilégio de ficar num dos recantos mais centrais e cheios de ambiente do Porto, onde a história e o romance se encontram à porta.
